name: Monthly Safety Equipment Checklist
intro: Monthly USCG safety equipment inspection. Check every item — deficiencies must be reported and corrected immediately. This checklist satisfies the monthly safety documentation requirement.

items.label: All documents in order and up to date
items.info: COI, registration, FCC license, crew credentials

items.label: Certificate of Inspection (COI) posted and current
Horn tested and operational
VHF radio tested — transmit and receive
Navigation lights tested — all working
EPIRB tested — registration, battery, and hydrostat up to date

help.title: EPIRB check
help.body: Verify: 1) Registration current, 2) Battery not expired, 3) Hydrostat release mechanism not expired, 4) Self-test button produces signal. If any are expired, flag immediately.

items.label: Fire extinguishers charged and up to date
Fireboys (fixed system) charged and up to date
3 fire buckets aboard with lanyards and lettering
Emergency fuel shutoff tested and operational

help.title: Fuel shutoff test
help.body: Physically test the emergency fuel shutoff. Make sure it operates smoothly and shuts off fuel flow completely. Reset after testing.

items.label: Flares sufficient quantity and not expired
Smoke signals present and not expired
Ring buoy and strobe tested
Lifejackets — correct count, properly stowed, good repair
items.info: Must meet or exceed COI passenger capacity

items.label: Kids sport life jackets available and in good repair
Whistle present and functional
Medical kit stocked and up to date
AED checked — battery and pads not expired
Reviewed laminated safety procedures in helm with mate
items.info: Walk through the emergency procedures with your mate — make sure they know where everything is

items.label: Steering system tested — no sponginess or play
Thru-hulls inspected — no leaks
Bilge pumps tested — manual and auto
Float switches tested and operational

completion.notes_prompt: Any deficiencies found? List corrective actions taken or needed.
